name: Xyrella
guide_text: Hero powering 1/1s and 1/2s in shop early on is great on this hero in the early game. Mid to late game just hero power good battlecries such as [[Rodeo Performer||104466]].
buddy_guide_text: You want to cycle as many cards as possible using [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] or other APM strats to scale up the buddy. Then, buying every Magnetic is worth it, especially if you ever find [[Polarizing Beatboxer||98713]].
